name: io.github.sr-dash/heliofleet-mcp
title: HelioFleet
description: Heliophysics spacecraft positions, alignments and solar magnetic connectivity from JPL ephemerides

environmentVariables.name: HELIOFLEET_SOURCE
environmentVariables.description: Where to read HelioFleet data: auto (site, then a local checkout), web, or local

environmentVariables.name: HELIOFLEET_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Path to a heliofleet/data folder for offline use

environmentVariables.name: HELIOFLEET_MCP_PLUGINS
environmentVariables.description: Optional tool sets: heliofield (coronal field and connectivity) or none
